articles.summary: MRAM a ‘must’ for Raven Bus GEO satellite mission Image stephanie.quinn Fri, 28 Aug 2026 - 13:21 In this Silicon Semiconductor interview, Sean Dougherty, Vice President of Worldwide Sales & Marketing at Everspin Technologies, joins editor Phil Alsop to discuss Astro Digital’s selection of PERSYST 64Mb STT-MRAM for an upcoming Raven bus geosynchronous Earth orbit (GEO) satellite mission. Sean explains why MRAM is well suited as persistent, non-volatile memory for critical boot, recovery and storage functions in long-duration space missions, and how the technology could play a broader role in mission-critical applications that depend on reliable access to data. articles.summary: Semiconductor Digest reports on Everspin’s $40 million agreement with a U.S. prime contractor to provide Toggle MRAM process technology, engineering support and foundry services for U.S. Defense Industrial Base programs. The two-and-a-half-year agreement will support military and aerospace applications that require reliable, long-life memory and a secure domestic supply. The article also notes Everspin’s foundry agreement with Microchip, which is expected to add U.S.-based manufacturing capacity for future MRAM production.
articles.title: Everspin Executes $40M Agreement for Mil-Aero MRAM Applications
